items.s: Swayamsidha Scheme launched in the year 2002 was dedicated to:
items.x: Swayamsiddha was an integrated, SHG-based scheme for women's empowerment (launched 2001), not a literacy or health scheme.

items.src: APPSC Technical Assistant (Hydrogeology) in AP Ground Water
items.s: The Green Revolution was introduced in which Five-Year Plan?
items.x:
Official key / most books: 3rd Plan. Strictly, the HYV programme began in kharif 1966, during the Annual Plans (Plan holiday 1966-69) just after the Third Plan (1961-66) (Rocket Indian Economy: 1966-67).
The new agricultural strategy (HYV seeds) behind the Green Revolution was introduced in the Third Five-Year Plan (1965), and showed results in the Annual Plans 1966-69.

items.s: Which of the following banks have launched World's first 250-Dollar Bank Notes?
items.x: Standard Chartered issued the world's first 150-dollar banknote (HK$150 commemorative, Hong Kong, 2009); the '250' in the question is evidently a misprint, and no bank issued a 250-dollar note.

items.src: APPSC Royalty Inspector, Agriculture Officer, Town Planning
items.s: Who is the present Chairman of SEBI?
items.x:
Ajay Tyagi was SEBI chief till Feb 2022 (then Madhabi Puri Buch) — now Tuhin Kanta Pandey (Praveen CA360 May 2026 p.35)
When asked, Ajay Tyagi was SEBI Chairman (March 2017 to Feb 2022), after U.K. Sinha (2011-17) (now Tuhin Kanta Pandey, from March 2025).

items.s: What is the share of subsidies in India's GDP during 2002-2003?
items.x: As keyed (APPSC G1 2003), total subsidies were put at about 7% of GDP in 2002-03 (Centre and States, explicit and implicit); central budget subsidies alone were under 2%.
